content: We need to determine number of carbonyl groups in the sample's compound. We have no SMILES given. We have tools to get spectra: carbon_nmr_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, hsqc_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra. Carbonyl groups show characteristic IR around 1700 cm-1, also carbonyl carbon in 13C NMR around 190-210 ppm. So we can retrieve IR spectra and look for peak near 1700. Use ir_spectra tool.
